title: Supreme Court announces court suspension in some areas on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026
summary: The Supreme Court announced that court operations in some areas in are suspended on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

blocks.text: The Supreme Court announced that court operations in some areas in are suspended on Thursday, November 19, 2026.
The areas affected are the following:

items: RTC, Branch 24, Cabugao and MTCs of Cabugao and Sinait in Ilocos Sur - power interruption
RTC OCC and Branches 71, 23 and 8-FC; and MTCC in Candon City, Ilocos Sur - power interruption
All courts in Legazpi City; MCTC Camalig-Jovellar; and Family Court 2, Daraga in Albay - power interruption

blocks.text: Refresh this page for updates. — BAP, GMA News
